prompt:
A single board-game playing piece, like a carved chess piece, standing upright on a small round base, seen from the front and very slightly above, painted in a rustic 1990s hand-painted trading-card style (gouache and ink, rich antique colours, slightly worn, soft light from the top left), like the painted medallions on an old fantasy map. A bold, simple silhouette that still reads at 40 pixels tall: a tall narrow piece, the whole figure in view, centred, filling most of the height. Fully transparent background, no ground, no table, no cast shadow, no border, no text, no letters.

Subject: Sun Wukong the Monkey King as a game piece carved from green jade with red lacquer and gold details: the monkey hero holding his golden staff upright, the golden circlet on his head, a little cloud carved into the base. Chinese, colours of jade green, vermilion and gold.
